money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/Bank Guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Kolkata, payable at Kolkata, valid three months from technical bid opening; exemption not allowed; original to reach office by last date of bid submission. Tender fee Nil.

Similar works: repairs & maintenance or construction work of any type of building (RCC or masonry)
Notarised affidavit (2024) of not being blacklisted or debarred; undertaking that price bid is unconditional
ITR for FY 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24; tender acceptance letter; other documents per Section VI
